last_3_comments.body:
## Proposal

### Re-state problem

This is a bug, not a surface issue. After the custom workflows are created and Gusto is connected, the workspace is saved with Gusto’s Manager approval mode instead of preserving Custom approval. PR #102750 is only where QA discovered the regression.

### Root cause

The App renders Gusto’s stored connection approval mode directly, so the Manager label means the connection was initialized with `MANAGER`. It is not a copy or selection-list issue.

https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/fe288f387af20cbd2fd9b51c9751ab13b9b5481e/src/pages/workspace/hr/gusto/GustoA
